system.description: This thrown weapon explodes with shrapnel, concussive force, gas, or bright chemical light, and sounds. There are three types of grenades used by Stargate Phoenix: Fragmentation grenades are the “standard” Grenade and use the attributes noted for grenades. Characters proficient in common weapons or explosives are considered proficient with grenades. A grenade is thrown at a point (see page 157) rather than at a target and goes off at the start of the throwing character’s next turn (or 6 seconds after release).
